text.t01: [excited] Come forth, dragon of the skies…! …Eh?
text.t02: [surprised] …Oh? You are not… a dragon. …A person?
text.t03a: [flustered] I-I'm terribly sorry…! I was supposed to be summoning a dragon…
text.t03b: [softly] This is the Royal Celesta Academy of Magic. The great summoning hall.
text.t03c: [warmly] I am Tsubaki, of the summoning class.
text.t04: [surprised] …My. We understand each other. [giggles] Hehe, how lovely.
text.t05: [curious] Those curious clothes… Could you be from another world…?
text.t06: [warmly] Rest easy. The circle home is atop the astronomy tower. It opens at dawn.
text.t07: [whispers] …The truth is, this is the first time a summoning of mine has ever worked. …Our secret.
text.t08: [cheerful] Now, let's be on our way before dawn. Please, ride on my broom.
text.t09: [cheerful] Hold on tight, please. …Here we go!
text.t10: [excited] Look — that is the academy, and over there, the Stargazing Lake.
text.t11: [curious] How fast would you like to go?
text.t12b: [warmly] Certainly. Then, very gently… [excited] Full speed it is!
text.t13x: [surprised] Oh, your hands…! A-are you all right? Once more, then.
text.t14: [laughs] Hehe, hehehe! The wind feels wonderful, doesn't it!
text.t16: [curious] …Are there things that fly in your world too?
text.t17: [softly] We'll land at the workshop underground. Cocoa will surely help us.
text.c01: [cheerful] Welcome~! …Oh, Tsubaki. Did you summon something again?
text.c02: [giggles] Hehe, what a cute guest. I'm Cocoa. I run this workshop.
text.c03: [softly] Don't get too close to the ice cabinet on the left. I keep snow-crystal ingredients in there.
text.c04: [playful] Tonight's potion is… the 'makes-everything-sweet potion'! A pinch of fire-salamander scale…
text.c05: [surprised] Eek…! [giggles] …Ehehe, I put in a bit too much. That was warm, wasn't it?
text.c06: [softly] Here, all done. …Though really, it's just hot cocoa.
text.c07: [warmly] …Your cheek is cold. Hold the cup right here.
text.c09: [whispers] …There, it's cooler now. …Before you drink, say "itadakimasu"?
text.c10: [cheerful] Enjoy! …Is it good? Ehehe, I'm so glad.
text.c11: [whispers] …Hey. There's no such thing as a sweetening potion. The only thing that's sweet… is me, to you.
text.c12: [curious] …Hey, tell me about the sweets in your world?
text.l01: [softly] …Welcome. Not many people climb all the way up here.
text.l02: [softly] I'm Luna. I teach ice and night magic. …Sit. By the fire.
text.l04: [softly] …This is ice magic. It's real ice, so when it comes close… it's cold, isn't it.
text.l07: [whispers] …There, your left ear. The fire and the ice. Warm and cold together. …Strange feeling?
text.l09a: [laughs softly] …Heh. It's beautiful because it melts so soon.
text.l09b: [playful] …Heh. It's ice, after all. …Shall I warm you up?
text.l10: [whispers] …You can stay here until dawn. …Though it's a little lonely, you going home.
text.l11: [curious] …Tell me. In your world, can you see the stars at night?
text.t19: [excited] Dawn is breaking! The circle is opening!
text.c14: [cheerful] Take a souvenir! …Hmm, what should it be?
text.l12: [softly] …Choose just one. From one of us.
text.t20: [whispers] …My camellia ornament. …Next time I'll summon you properly. Not a dragon — you.
text.c15: [whispers] …My ribbon. …Think of me whenever you eat something sweet. Promise?
text.l13: [whispers] …My moon earring. …On nights you can't sleep, look at the sky. …It's the same moon.
text.bt_future: [curious] A smartphone…? You can talk to faraway people from your palm? …Why, that's magic.
text.bt_magic: [warmly] If it's about magic, leave it to me. …Anything but summoning.
text.bt_food: [curious] The academy dining hall's pastries are delicious, you know. Let's go together next time.
text.bt_cold: [softly] Are you cold? Please, take my capelet.
text.bt_sleep: [softly] If you're tired, please, rest on my shoulder. I won't drop you.
text.bt_praise: [flustered] G-goodness… No one has ever said that to me before…
text.bt_name: [warmly] Tsubaki. It's the name of a red flower that blooms in winter.
text.bt_thanks: [warmly] No need to thank me. I'm the one who summoned you. I'll take responsibility.
text.bt_leave: [softly] …Of course you want to go home. Please, wait just a little until dawn.
text.bt_yes: [excited] Oh my, really?! I would love to ride one!
text.bt_no: [surprised] My… Then this is your first time flying? …What an honour.
text.bt_gen1: [curious] My… I would love to hear more about your world.
text.bt_gen2: [giggles] Hehe… Forgive me, I only understood about half of that.
text.bt_silence: [softly] …Hehe. Up in the sky, the wind carries our words away.
text.bc_future: [curious] Ooh, sweets from the future?! Won't you secretly tell me the recipe?
text.bc_magic: [playful] Alchemy is halfway between magic and cooking. When it fails, it goes boom, though.
text.bc_food: [cheerful] Right~! Sweet things are my speciality! There's more if you want?
text.bc_cold: [softly] If you're cold, hold the cup tight in both hands. …See, warm, right?
text.bc_sleep: [giggles] Aww, sleepy? Cocoa does make you drowsy.
text.bc_name: [cheerful] I'm Cocoa! Sweet and warm, like cocoa. Easy to remember, right?
text.bc_thanks: [warmly] You're welcome. The price is… coming to visit again!
text.bc_leave: [softly] …I'll miss you when you go. But stay here until dawn, okay?
text.bc_yes: [excited] Really?! Then next time, let's make some together!
text.bc_no: [pouting] Eh~, there aren't any? …Then I'll make you your very first one.
text.bc_gen2: [curious] Uh-huh…? I don't really get it, but it sounds fun!
text.bl_future: [softly] …Nights in the future are too bright. Poor stars.
text.bl_magic: [playful] …My magic lessons are only at night. …For you, a private lesson would do.
text.bl_food: [softly] …The tea biscuits are Cocoa's. …Too sweet is just right.
text.bl_cold: [softly] …Cold? Move closer to the fire. …Or closer to me?
text.bl_sleep: [whispers] …If you're sleepy, sleep. I'll wake you at dawn.
text.bl_praise: [laughs softly] …Heh. Smooth talker. …I don't mind it.
text.bl_name: [softly] …Luna. It means the moon. …A name you can only meet at night.
text.bl_thanks: [softly] …No thanks needed. …You coming up here is thanks enough.
text.bl_leave: [softly] …You want to go home. …Dawn isn't far. Until then, you're my guest.
text.bl_yes: [softly] …I see. Good. …Wherever you are, the sky is the same sky.
text.bl_no: [softly] …I see. Then tonight's stars are all yours.
text.bl_gen2: [laughs softly] …Heh. I didn't understand half of it. …But I want to keep listening.
text.bl_silence: [softly] …Being quiet together makes a good night too.
text.ht1: [warmly] Oh, back in the great hall? Hehe, this is my favourite place.
text.ht2: [softly] The circle's light is neither warm nor cold. Just light. …But pretty, isn't it?
text.ht3: [curious] Please, come by the brazier. This stone hall gets cold, doesn't it?
text.ht4: [whispers] …The next time I summon, I will think of you while I chant.
text.hc1: [cheerful] Wow, the summoning hall. I'm always shut away underground, so it's been ages!
text.hc2: [whispers] …I'm glad Tsubaki's summoning went wrong. …Or we'd never have met.
text.hl1: [softly] …The great hall's ceiling is too high. I can't settle here.
text.hl2: [whispers] …But it's where you appeared. …So I've come to like it, a little.
text.st1: [excited] Another stroll in the sky! Where shall we go this time?
text.st2: [laughs] Hehe, I had the best broom licence in my year. …Safe flying was second, though.
text.st3: [softly] The sunset still lingers in the sky on the right. …That way lies the western kingdom.
text.st4: [whispers] …Hold tight so you don't fall. …Yes, just like that.
text.lc1: [cheerful] Welcome back~! You came again. What shall we make today?
text.lc2: [playful] A baby fire salamander lives in this furnace. Her name is Marshmallow.
text.lc3: [softly] Professor Luna froze the cabinet on the left for me. Even in summer, the snow never melts.
text.lc4: [curious] Hey, is there alchemy in your world too?
text.lc5: [whispers] …Come again for cocoa. I'll always keep it warm for you.
text.lt1: [curious] My, Cocoa's workshop always smells so sweet.
text.lt2: [flustered] Um… I once made a pot explode in here… That's a secret, all right?
text.ll1: [softly] …Cocoa's workshop is too warm. …But I like the biscuits here.
text.ll2: [whispers] …I sometimes come and top up the ice in her cabinet. …Don't tell Cocoa.
text.wl1: [softly] …You came again. …All right. I'll make tea.
text.wl2: [softly] …The windows of this tower stay open all year. So the stars can be seen.
text.wl3: [playful] …Shall I send another piece of ice around you?
text.wl4: [curious] …In your world, what is your favourite kind of night?
text.wt1: [curious] Professor Luna's tea party…! This is my first time being invited.
text.wt2: [whispers] …The professor looks stern, but she is truly kind, you know.
text.wc1: [cheerful] Professor Luna~, I baked biscuits! …Oh, you're here too!
text.wc2: [whispers] …The professor's ice is super cold, right? …Let me warm you up.
text.dt1: [softly] The morning sun… Thank you for staying with us all night.
text.dc1: [softly] Why not have breakfast before you go? …No? I see.
text.dl1: [softly] …I'm not much of a morning person. …But today's sunrise isn't bad.
text.tt2: [cheerful] Before you go, let's chat a little?
text.tt3: [softly] …If there's something you want to say, now's the time.
text.tt4: [warmly] Please stay well, in your world too.
text.bt_p_circle: [warmly] The circle's light has no warmth of its own. What's warm is the brazier fire.
text.bc_p_circle: [curious] So up close, a magic circle sparkles this much…
text.bl_p_circle: [softly] …Summoning light is only light. …What's cold is the stone floor.
text.bt_p_wind: [laughs] Hehe, the stronger the wind, the faster we are flying!
text.bt_p_lab: [curious] That big furnace always has a fire in it. So warm…
text.bc_p_lab: [cheerful] The furnace on the right, the ice cabinet on the left. So here it's half warm, half cold!
text.bl_p_lab: [softly] …The furnace fire and my ice. …This workshop is always quarrelling.
text.bt_p_tower: [softly] The stars are close up on the tower. …As if I could reach them.
text.bc_p_tower: [softly] The night wind through the window is cold. …But with the fire, it's fine.
text.bl_p_tower: [softly] …The fire on the left, the night sky on the right. …Which one do your ears like right now?
text.bt_p_dawn: [excited] When the sun rises, the circle opens. That's what the academy says!
text.bc_p_dawn: [softly] The morning sun is warm. …Before you go, let me warm your cheek once more.
text.bl_p_dawn: [softly] …It's a little sad when the night ends. …But if you can go home, it's a good morning.
